entities.summary: Gavin Marcel Valentin Schilling is a German professional basketball player who last played for Basketball Löwen Braunschweig in the German Basketball Bundesliga (BBL). He stands 6’9’’ (206 cm) tall and plays power forward. Schilling played college basketball for the Michigan State Spartans.
